sentences.japanese: 学寮長のベイカーさんは、それゆえに自分の所有する小さい車のために、駐車場に特別なスペースを設けた。
sentences.english: The head of the college, Miss Baker, had a special place in the car park for her small car.

sentences.japanese: 会議場内で自社の製品の展示場を設けたいとお考えでしたら、早急にご連絡下さい。
sentences.english: Please let me know immediately if you would like to set up an area of the conference room for your products.

sentences.japanese: 英国は多くの植民地を設けた。
ホールは仕切りを設ける前は千人収容できた。
sentences.english: The hall could seat a thousand people before it was partitioned.

sentences.japanese: その映画監督は自分の権力を使って、映画界に特別な場を設けました。
sentences.english: The director used his power to arrange a special place in the cinema world.
